say:1:1720913001:1.text: Fast work. I'll give you that... But when you write the official piece, punch it up a little. Make it more sensational. More detail, more drama!
say:1:1720913001:1.source_cn: 嗯……效率还不错，这次就先这样吧。记得在写正式报道的时...

say:4:1720913003:1.text: Haria's story isn't very compelling. To catch the mysterious reporter's attention, you'll need something juicier—someone important, a more dramatic story, and a lead that aligns with the Savannah Eye's interests.
say:4:1720913003:1.source_cn: 赫蒂奇提供的新闻线索在你看来吸引力堪忧。你需要一条主人...

document:6:523:0.text: The Queen allegedly held a secret meeting with Master Rowan from the Mithril Consortium, instructing him to use his business connections to identify individuals opposed to Princess Peggy. A list is said to have been compiled, raising concerns that action may be taken against those named.
document:6:523:0.source_cn: 秘银商会内部人士爆料！王后秘密召见了秘银商会的罗万少爷，要他用商界人脉调查那些对佩吉公主不利的人，罗万已经整理出一份名单，王后疑似要针对名单上的人展开报复！
